scenes.title:
What would
you take?
scenes.blurb: One pick can get a whole draft group talking.
scenes.narration: Quick question. When you open a draft pack, how long does it take you to decide what you'd pick? That's the fun part for me.

scenes.title:
The fun is
in the decision.
scenes.blurb: Look at the options. Make your call. See a different perspective.
scenes.narration: I love looking at a pack, weighing a couple of options, and finding out what another drafter would have done. It's a surprisingly fun thing to practice.

scenes.title:
So I built
Pack One.
scenes.blurb: A daily drafting game, focused on individual pick decisions.
scenes.narration: That's why I built Pack One. It's a daily game around those individual decisions, without asking you to sit through an entire draft.

scenes.title:
8 separate picks.
8 trophy drafts.
scenes.blurb: Each decision starts in a different real trophy draft.
scenes.narration: Each challenge has eight picks from eight different real trophy drafts. Not eight picks from the same draft. Eight separate situations, each with its own context.

scenes.title:
Make your pick.
Then compare.
scenes.blurb: See the pack and the cards the original drafter already took.
scenes.narration: You see the pack and what that player had already drafted. You make your choice, lock it in, and then find out what the trophy drafter actually picked.

scenes.title:
Disagreement
is the point.
scenes.blurb: Sometimes you match. Sometimes you'd still take something else.
scenes.narration: Sometimes you match their pick. Sometimes you still like your own choice better. Either way, there's something to think about, and maybe something to argue about with friends.

scenes.title: Share your result.
scenes.blurb: A score to compare. A few picks worth discussing.
scenes.narration: At the end, you get a score and a Share button. Send it to your draft group and see who made the same calls. A different pick doesn't automatically mean it was a bad one.

scenes.title:
3 new Dailies.
Every day.
scenes.blurb: Draft Run  /  Powered Cube  /  Latest Set
scenes.narration: There are three new Dailies every day. Draft Run, Powered Cube, and Latest Set. You can play one or try all three.

scenes.title:
Eight picks.
Your call.
scenes.narration: If you like drafting, give Pack One a try. Pick your cards, share your result, and tell me which decision you found the hardest. I'd really like to hear what you think.
